home.about_text: Clearwater Plumbing is a family-run plumbing company in Charlotte. We fix leaks, clear drains and install water heaters for homes across the area.
home.area_text: We serve homes in Charlotte, Matthews, Mint Hill, Huntersville, Concord, Pineville and Indian Trail.

faq.q: How do you fix a leak in my home?
faq.a: We trace the leak to its source, behind walls or under floors, then repair the pipe and fitting. We also check the water pressure.

faq.q: How do you clear a slow or blocked drain?
faq.a: We clear slow and blocked drains by snaking or hydro-jetting. When it keeps coming back, we take a camera look at the line.

faq.q: Do you repair or replace water heaters?
faq.a: We repair tank and tankless water heaters or replace them, often the same day. We remove the old heater and check safety valves and venting.
We give free estimates for our work. Tell us what you see and we will help you plan the next step.

faq.q: Is your work backed by a warranty?
faq.a: Our work is backed by a 1-year workmanship warranty. The business answers questions about coverage on the phone.

home.cta_heading: See a leak or have no hot water?
home.cta_text: Tell us what you see and we will help you plan the next step.
